title: toxicodendron laevigatum
intro: Toxicodendron laevigatum, commonly known as smooth sumac, is a deciduous shrub native to the eastern United States and southeastern Canada. It is a member of the Anacardiaceae family, known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health and act as an antioxidant. Smooth sumac has been used for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of smooth sumac include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
